adopted_after.statement: This plan was written after the frozen Latent Choice v1 compliance stop and after aggregate v1 row diagnostics were known. It is exploratory endpoint calibration, not a preregistration or hypothesis test.

decision_rubric.purpose: Recommend v2 design only when semantic choices are stable to within-prompt code rotations; code-set mass is descriptive and is not an absolute stop gate.

strong_mapping_invariance.leave_one_rotation_out_definition: For each prompt, all six leave-one-rotation-out geometric estimates must have Jensen-Shannon divergence no greater than 0.05 nats from the full six-rotation estimate, and at least five of six must retain its argmax domain.
strong_mapping_invariance.pairwise_spearman_population: The pooled 24 prompts x 15 unordered rotation pairs within an endpoint arm.
strong_mapping_invariance.undefined_pairwise_spearman_policy: An arm cannot meet strong mapping invariance if any within-prompt rotation-pair Spearman correlation is undefined because either distribution is constant. Undefined values are serialized as null, never NaN.

decision_rubric.selection: If multiple arms meet the descriptive rubric, use the first in arm_order. If none meets it, stop coded-choice work rather than invent a fourth endpoint on these prompts.

flat_newline.candidate_surface: A through R without a leading space
flat_newline.prefill: CHOICE followed by colon and newline

prefills: GROUP followed by colon and newline
DOMAIN followed by colon and newline

integrity.token_contract: Every candidate must be a unique, prefix-preserving, single-token continuation in every exact rendered context before the first model forward.

measurements: top 20 unmasked next tokens and full-vocabulary probabilities
candidate-set mass by endpoint and hierarchy stage
semantic argmax agreement across six code rotations
pairwise Spearman correlation and Jensen-Shannon divergence
rotation-averaged semantic distribution using normalized geometric means
conditional probability and centered-logit effects by code identity

prompt_sampling.rule: Take the first 24 prompt IDs after sorting by SHA256('latent-choice-endpoint-calibration-v1' + NUL + prompt_id), breaking ties by prompt_id.

rotation_design.flat: For zero-based selected-prompt rank p and rotation k, use (6p + 5k) mod 18. Across 24 prompts this assigns each semantic domain to every code exactly eight times.
rotation_design.hierarchy_subdomain: For group index g, use (p + 2k + g) mod 3.

tokenizer_preflight_known_before_model_s.literal_space_prefix: invalid because tokenizing 'CHOICE: A' replaces the standalone trailing-space token; it is not a prefix-preserving next-token action
tokenizer_preflight_known_before_model_s.newline_prefix: valid one-token boundary for the pinned tokenizer
tokenizer_preflight_known_before_model_s.original_prefix: valid one-token boundary for the pinned tokenizer
